games.title: Cargo Loop
games.tagline: Release cargo onto a loop, flip switches to route it to the right truck.
games.description: A prototype. Tap a yard column to feed a crate onto the belt, tap a switch to decide which lane it takes, and tap a parked crate to send it round again once a truck wants it. A full holding dock is a jam. Built to test one question: is deciding where cargo goes better than only deciding which cargo to release?
games.controls: Tap a pile to feed it. Tap the switch to route. Tap a parked crate to re-send.
games.engine: Vanilla JS, one HTML file, no engine

games.title: Lumen Relay
games.tagline: Tap mirrors to bend light into the crystals, without touching a bomb.
games.description: A prototype. A beam leaves an emitter and you rotate mirrors to steer it into every matching receiver inside a move limit. Splitters fork it, tint gates recolour it, and bombs end the level. Every board is generated and then verified: it ships only if it is solvable, has few enough solutions, and a random bot wins it as rarely as that level intends.
games.controls: Tap a mirror to rotate it. Undo, hint and retry are limited.
games.engine: Vanilla JS, one HTML file, no engine

games.title: Perigee
games.tagline: Hold to orbit a planet, let go to sling. Endless gravity arcade.
games.description: The landscape sibling to Jetpack Slinger. Hold to fall into orbit around the nearest planet, release to sling yourself onward. Bounce pads on the rails throw you back into play; everything else on them does not.
games.controls: Hold to orbit. Release to sling.
games.engine: Vanilla JS, one HTML file, no engine

games.title: Jetpack Slinger
games.tagline: Hold to hook a pole, release at the top of the swing, climb.
games.description: A one-thumb vertical climber. You get a single jetpack burn to leave the ground; after that every metre is stolen from a swing. Hold anywhere to throw a tether at the nearest pole, let go at the top of the arc, and you fire off in whatever direction you were already going. Release early and you waste it; release late and gravity has already taken it back.
games.controls: Hold anywhere to hook. Release to fly.
games.engine: Vanilla JS, one HTML file, no engine
